description: Official-source discovery and ingestion registry. Candidate URLs are not indexed content unless marked ingested. Access and reuse conditions must be checked before collection or redistribution.

sources.title: Kharif Agro-Advisories for Farmers 2025
sources.recommended_use: Historical, season-specific text retrieval; preserve PDF pages and label 2025 Kharif, not current advice.
sources.access_note: Fetch was not successful in this environment; source content was not added.

sources.title: Agricultural Meteorology Division
sources.recommended_use: Capture crop/district bulletin issue time, validity interval, issuing unit, and observation or forecast type.

sources.title: Crop-specific advisories
sources.recommended_use: Treat each bulletin as time-bounded; query issue date and validity before displaying as current.

sources.title: Climate Data Services announcement
sources.recommended_use: Use for data-service context and access terms; not as a substitute for weather forecasts.

sources.title: Climate anomaly time series
sources.recommended_use: Keep period, anomaly baseline, units, station/grid, and data revision attached; historical normals are not forecasts.

sources.organization: ICAR-Central Research Institute for Dryland Agriculture
sources.title: District Agricultural Contingency Plans
sources.recommended_use: Index by district, scenario, crop, issue/publication date; label older plans historical.
sources.access_note: Fetch was unsuccessful in this environment; source content was not added.

sources.organization: ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning
sources.title: Soil survey and digital soil mapping resources
sources.recommended_use: Preserve map scale/resolution, coordinate reference system, survey date, method, and limits; do not convert pixels into unsupported prose.

sources.organization: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.title: Soil Health Card portal
sources.recommended_use: Use public scheme documentation only; do not assume individual farm cards are open or authorized for bulk use.

sources.organization: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.title: Soil Health Card FAQ
sources.recommended_use: Definitions and scheme context for pH, EC, organic carbon, N/P/K, and micronutrients.

sources.organization: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.title: Area, Production and Yield reports
sources.recommended_use: Store crop/year/state/district/season, units, estimate status, and exact report query as structured records.
sources.access_note: The catalog URL was supplied for discovery; the tested APY report view is recorded separately.

sources.organization: Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.title: Area, Production and Yield report portal
sources.recommended_use: Store crop/year/state/district/season, units, estimate status, report filters, source row reference, and retrieval date.
sources.access_note: Portal UI was queried for the all-district Punjab/Wheat/Rabi/2022-2023 report. Twenty-three district rows were manually transcribed; estimate status was not shown. Hashes identify visible normalized rows, not downloaded source files.

sources.title: District-wise, season-wise crop production statistics
sources.recommended_use: Use resource-level update metadata and geographic/season/year dimensions; do not assume catalog records are current.
sources.access_note: Catalog fetch returned HTTP 403 in this environment; no records were imported.

sources.title: Ground Water Level Monitoring
sources.recommended_use: Retain reporting period, measurement season, station/geography, units, and collection method for each observation.
sources.access_note: Fetch was unsuccessful in this environment; source content was not added.

sources.title: Dynamic Ground Water Resources of India
sources.recommended_use: Keep assessment year, assessment unit, classification, and report/table citation with every value.

sources.title: Soil applications and mapping
sources.recommended_use: Record map scale/resolution, date, method, units, and whether layers are modeled estimates or field observations.

sources.title: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: How to Manage Water
sources.recommended_use: General international context on soil texture, groundwater depth, and rice water input; not an India-specific soil recommendation or a yield ranking.
sources.access_note: Curator-written summary based on the linked public page. The source does not establish a universally best soil type or an optimal soil pH; check IRRI reuse terms before redistribution.
